verdict.rationale: No evidence of any telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting or privacy control for AI features; evidence only covers unrelated product features, pricing, and community complaints about data-handling practices (e.g., MTurk receipt processing) that if anything raise privacy concerns rather than showing an opt-out mechanism. Missing for 10: any documentation of a telemetry/usage-tracking toggle, privacy settings page, or opt-out API/flag.
